caption: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and crisp menma. Topped with shredded cabbage and green onions, it sits in a white bowl on a wooden table, bathed in warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, appearing smooth and slightly reflective.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with a glossy, caramelized surface and visible fat marbling.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and toppings.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale, translucent, slightly curved strips with a smooth, glossy surface.
White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, subtle rim, and faint orange residue along inner edge.
